title: Diagnose ownership and group access
goal: Repair narrow group read access and prove it under the intended identity.
challenge: Create ll-u4 plus ll-u4team and the supplied root-owned 0600 note in /srv/ll-u4. Make only root and team members able to read it, while nobody remains denied. Do not change owner to the learner or grant world access.

steps.command: ! getent passwd ll-u4 && ! getent group ll-u4 && test ! -e /home/ll-u4 && sudo useradd -m -U -s /bin/bash ll-u4
steps.explanation: Fail closed if this disposable name or home exists. -m creates a home from /etc/skel; -U creates a primary group; no password is set.
steps.expected: Fresh account ll-u4, same-named primary group, home and Bash shell. A nonzero status/collision means stop setup.

steps.command: ! getent group ll-u4team && test ! -e /srv/ll-u4 && sudo groupadd ll-u4team && sudo usermod -aG ll-u4team ll-u4 && sudo install -d -m 0755 /srv/ll-u4
steps.explanation: Accessible parents allow testing file access separately from traversal.
steps.expected: Disposable group membership and root-owned guest fixture directory.

steps.command: printf 'handover\n' | sudo tee /srv/ll-u4/note.txt; sudo chmod 0600 /srv/ll-u4/note.txt; sudo stat -c '%U:%G %a' /srv/ll-u4/note.txt; sudo runuser -u ll-u4 -- cat /srv/ll-u4/note.txt
steps.explanation: A root-only file is initially denied to the new user. A failure is expected evidence.
Group ownership selects eligible readers; group read grants only read. Neither membership nor mode alone repairs both faults.

steps.command: sudo runuser -u ll-u4 -- cat /srv/ll-u4/note.txt; sudo runuser -u nobody -- cat /srv/ll-u4/note.txt
steps.explanation: Use two actual process identities. Root reading successfully is not access evidence for either user.
steps.expected: ll-u4 reads handover; nobody denied. ll-u4 cannot append.

hints: Inspect every path component before changing the file.
0600 still denies group members; 0644 would leak to unrelated users.
Pair the intended group owner with group-read and test access as that user.
review: Retain original denial, final root:ll-u4team 640, successful ll-u4 read and denied outsider/read-write.
No world access or unnecessary execute bits.
coverage: LPIC-1 104.5 ownership/group permissions; 107.1 reinforcement. Partial coverage; original material, self-review only. No automatic assessment or full LPIC preparation.
